links.comparator_used: Baseline LLM-generated summaries without knowledge-graph retrieval (no retrieval)
links.outcome: NLI-based faithfulness of LLM-generated clinical trial summaries (entailment and faithfulness scores)
links.effect: entailment +0.0125, faithfulness +0.0130, p < 0.0001; GPT-4o improved mainly through contradiction reduction, Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Gemini 2.5 Flash through increased entailment
links.quote: A knowledge-graph-augmented retrieval system was developed and evaluated against the baseline, producing statistically significant improvements in NLI-based faithfulness scores (entailment +0.0125, faithfulness +0.0130, p < 0.0001).
